annotations.title: Send or schedule a Mailchimp campaign

description: SEND or SCHEDULE a Mailchimp campaign draft. An email cannot be unsent, so this is gated on how many people it reaches: without confirm:true nothing is sent and you get Mailchimp's own recipient count with the subject, sender, audience, timing and Mailchimp's send checklist. Show the user that number; only after they say yes call again with confirm:true AND confirmRecipients set to that count (a mismatch, a zero, or a campaign Mailchimp says is not ready is refused). sendTime (ISO, in the future, on :00/:15/:30/:45; Mailchimp schedules only on the quarter-hour) schedules instead of sending now; timewarp:true sends at that time in each recipient's own timezone. Free. Needs Mailchimp connected (Settings > Connectors > Mailchimp, or connect_connector with an API key).

confirm.description: true only after the user approved this exact send

confirmRecipients.description: the recipient count the dry run showed the user

sendTime.description: ISO date-time on the quarter-hour; omit to send now
